compatibility_authority: Runtime STATUS compatibility profile/version and the protocol files supplied with the checkout or ZIP are authoritative. Git revisions are evidence only when observable.
observed_revision_evidence: Trace source_evidence records Python/protocol Git commit and dirty state when Git metadata is available, otherwise records them as unavailable.

coverage: System Information discovery with exact protocol-version validation
fixed instruction upload with explicit finalization and deferred results
two-chunk variable upload covering digital, analog, PWM, UART, SPI, and CAN operations
sparse variable tick upload with an empty result for an omitted tick
bounded result polling with one pending output and no result acknowledgements
application_v03.scope_limit: The firmware harness is a deterministic synthetic loopback and does not drive physical peripherals; hardware commands are evidence-gathering only until a real board is connected.

expected_usb_identity.pid: project hardware value or explicit selector
expected_usb_identity.serial_number: preferred for reset/re-enumeration testing when available
